name: sushegaad/claude-skills-governance-risk-and-compliance
description: A governance, risk, and compliance plugin catalogue (README claims 36 skills under plugins/*/skills/*/, including ccpa, cis-controls, cmmc, and more). The sample skill, ccpa, guides CCPA compliance work.
install: /plugin marketplace add Sushegaad/Claude-Skills-Governance-Risk-and-Compliance, then /plugin install for named skills (for example iso27001@grc-skills, soc2@grc-skills, fedramp@grc-skills, nist-csf@grc-skills, cmmc@grc-skills)
